## Checklist

- [ ] Branch is named `<type>/<slug>` (`feat/`, `fix/`, `docs/`, `chore/`, `refactor/`).
- [ ] `pytest`, `ruff check .` and `ruff format --check .` pass locally.
- [ ] Source changes under `src/` come with test changes under `tests/`. CI fails a source-only diff.
- [ ] `docs/features/<YYYY-MM-DD>-<slug>.md` and `docs/summaries/<YYYY-MM-DD>-<slug>.md` exist.
- [ ] Nothing reads, prints, or stores tokens or account identifiers.
- [ ] I said which platform I tested on (macOS, Windows, or neither).
